rv.q: All in all, this play is extraordinarily fun.
There’s a lot to like in Refracted Theatre Company’s gutsy production of I’M GONNA MARRY YOU TOBEY MAGUIRE.
All in all, it comes somewhat recommended.
It's still very funny, but there's little else. There's only so much that actors can do.
But at least in this production, too much in Hurley’s play operates at the level of self-conscious histrionics.
I'm Gonna Marry You Tobey Maguire is delightfully unhinged and brings a surprising amount of comedy and heartfelt moments.
While bawdy references and clever one-liners hold our attention, the show is ultimately too convoluted and contrived to be satisfying.

cn.t: This dark comedy about a teen kidnapping Tobey Maguire earns mixed reviews, with critics praising Alex O'Shea's unhinged lead performance but finding the premise descends unevenly from creative comedy into nightmarish horror.
